name: Sugar Lies
source:
"It makes me sick. This world is full of nothing but lies."

Akito Nagatsuki is a young man who detests lies.

Whenever he sees someone lying or acting, he feels physically repulsed and nauseous.

But then, he meets Yui Sakuramiya, a girl more skilled than anyone at playing the role of her ideal self.

The moment their eyes met, Akito understood immediately:

This was the worst encounter imaginable.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4839490/Sugar_Lies/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“真是令人作呕。这个世界上充斥着彻头彻尾的谎言。”

长月信人是一名深恶痛绝谎言的青年。

每当目睹有人说谎或是逢场作戏，他都会产生生理性的排斥与反胃感。

然而某一天，他邂逅了樱美夜梦衣——一位比任何人都更擅长扮演“理想中的自己”的少女。

四目相对的那一瞬间，信人立刻便明白了：

这是一场再糟糕不过的邂逅。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4839490/Sugar_Lies/]Steam[/url]]
